articles.title: Why these 7 stocks will be in focus on Friday
articles.summary: Infosys Finacle's Digital Banking Solution, hosted on Microsoft Azure, has been chosen by Investec, a prominent international bank and wealth manager. This collaboration aims to modernize Investec's banking operations, enhancing efficiency and customer experience. This move highlights the global application of advanced digital platforms for efficient financial services, showcasing Indian tech capabilities on an international stage.

articles.title: Russian missile destroys US firm’s Kyiv drone factory
articles.summary: Russia reportedly destroyed a US-owned drone factory in Kyiv with a ballistic missile on Friday. This marks a significant escalation, as it appears to be the first instance of Moscow directly targeting a US corporation during the conflict. The Delaware-registered company's facility underscores the complex international involvement in the Ukraine war, raising concerns about broader geopolitical implications and potential direct confrontation.

articles.title: NZ data centre builder contracts for new trans-Tasman link
articles.summary: The "Tasman Ring" submarine cable network, connecting Australia and New Zealand, has advanced significantly. Datagrid New Zealand signed delivery contracts with Malaysia's OMS Group and Alcatel Submarine Networks. This crucial infrastructure aims to greatly enhance high-speed data connectivity across the Tasman Sea, bolstering regional digital communication, economic ties, and overall resilience for both nations within the broader Pacific region.
